column1: # The := slice, try a07: a06 plus -- the walker-program dispatch of a statement (lm_compiler_rw_stmt_content, "A call
# statement") does not ask l2_call_head_method for a Frame `:=`: for a binding holding a callable the answer is the method
# held now, so `target := two` was emitted as a call of that method with the actual two ("more arguments than target has
# formals", found by gdb on fe165e); the statement falls to the binding store (lm_compiler_method_pointer_candidate) as
# natively. Run by `lmxtool steps` with the working tool of boot164a: pinned, kept in variants/tp165, copied into the
# stage; the source manifest of the stage written, then checked.
